# [DEVOUR THE WHOLE CITY WITH MASSIVE HOLES]
BLACK HOLE MASTER is a physics-fueled simulator where you play as an invader, ripping open giant holes to swallow the entire city and reveling in the chaotic reactions of its inhabitants.
